actors.name: NASA Senior Managers
actors.private_context: They are responsible for the Apollo 11 program and must decide whether to publicly announce a go decision for the July launch window after the flight readiness review. They have access to technical assessments and schedules, but the outcome of the review is not yet determined.

shared_context: The flight readiness review process for Apollo 11 is ongoing. A public announcement of a go decision for the July launch window would be made by senior managers after the review concludes. The review is expected to be completed before the end of June 1969.

starting_events.description: The flight readiness review process for Apollo 11 is underway.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that NASA senior managers publicly announced a go decision for Apollo 11's July launch window. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
